summary: Round 3 continued the finite-dimensional pose-confounded spectral-geometry study by following context/PARENT_ROUND3_AUDIT.md and adding four new empirical families (12-15), a read-only round-3 synthesis, and a compiled round-3 manuscript (manuscript/main_round3.tex -> main_round3.pdf, 54 pages, ~5.2 MB). No prior family 1-11 source/result/figure was overwritten. Family 12 replicated and dissected trajectory ordering across 4 scenes x 4 trajectories x 3 frequency sets x 2 controls: the prior ordering hypothesis held in 0/24 cells, raw vs normalized orderings agreed in 2/12 scene-frequency cells, and the c2 rank identity held in 93/96 cells with rank(B)=18 in all 96. Family 13 reproduced the ring-scene Family-9 rank residual and diagnosed the 6/7 boundary as a tolerance classification rather than a true rank change or unstable subtraction. Family 14 recomputed the affine tangent certificate exactly and explicitly demoted all full-nonlinear execution-error robustness claims to empirical/structural observations. Family 15 verified the Born composition identity exactly, characterized weak-vs-full deviations and subspace separation, and recorded that no quantitative external benchmark was possible. The round therefore provides a replicated negative trajectory-ordering result, a resolved rank-boundary classification, a retained finite-dimensional affine certificate, and a scoped robustness demotion.
key_results: Family 12 trajectory replication: the old ordering hypothesis holds in 0/24 scene-trajectory-frequency-control cells; rankings shift with scene, frequency set, and control; raw vs normalized orderings agree in only 2/12 scene-frequency cells.

Family 12 cross-checks: control B/F1/two_blob matches family4c to <=3e-7; stored family4_results.json order arc90 > straight > circle360 > arc180 was matched, with the instruction's transposed arc180/circle360 recorded and flagged.

Family 12 rank identity: c2 rank identity holds in 93/96 cells; the 3 exceptions are single-frequency near-null rank-threshold observations, not algebraic failures; rank(B)=18 in all 96 cells and per-pose normalization verified to 2.2e-16.

Family 13 rank autopsy: reproduced ring-scene residual exactly (r_A=24, r_B=18, r_AB=42, r_KIS=24, r_KSL=23). Verdict: tolerance classification. Evidence: sigma24(C)/sigma1(C)=4.75e-8 while sigma24(K_SLAM)/sigma1(K_SLAM)=2.26e-15 ~ (4.75e-8)^2; C stays full rank across predeclared relative tolerances 1e-16 to 1e-8; backward residual ||K_SLAM - C^T C||_F rel = 5.0e-16 with 1/s^2 reconstruction residual 1.5e-7.
Family 13 engineered rank event (algebraic falsifier) reproduces: rank(B) 18 to 17 at t=0, projector jump 1.0, retained mass 9.40716 to 10.40528, information jump 0.13996.

Family 14 robustness scope: affine tangent certificate recomputed exactly as L_cert_affine = 1.1309e-2, 1.1438e-2, 1.1895e-2 at eps = 1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2; FD Jacobians rel Fro 5.99e-7 (J_A) and 5.37e-7 (J_B). Full-nonlinear 500-direction worst quotient at eps=1e-2 is 3.23e-4 vs 1.19e-2 affine bound, ratio 36.8. Explicit demotion recorded: only the affine tangent certificate is retained as a finite-dimensional conditional certificate.

Family 15 Born control: Born composition identity A_born = G_S diag(E_inc) verified exactly (0.0). Observed log-log slopes approx 1 (A 1.0026, K_IS 0.9944, K_eff 0.9942). At s=0.1 Born-vs-full rel errors are A 5.05%, K_IS/K_eff 7.10%; at s=1.0 they are A 50.5%, K ~65.2%. Most-confounded Born vs full-wave subspaces nearly coincide at s=0.001 (~1e-3 deg) and separate to ~65 deg at s=1.0. No quantitative external benchmark was possible.
Round-3 manuscript compiled: manuscript/main_round3.tex -> manuscript/main_round3.pdf (54 pages, 5.2 MB), with Round-2 files untouched.
